Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: Ignored the Planner’s instruction to resolve Carl Boese’s conflicting birth year (1887 vs 1897) using authoritative sources (e.g., German Wikipedia, filmportal.de) and instead repeated searches on Fritz Lang. This left the key discrepancy unresolved and blocked reaching the correct conclusion that Carl Boese (1887) was born before Fritz Lang (1890), i.e., Five Million Look For An Heir.
